deficiencies.description: The rewrite converts the lecturer's deictic pointing gestures ('the tumor is here' and 'This is the outer surface') into a specific anatomical spatial relationship ('lies next to the outer surface of the uterus') that the text does not state.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus
deficiencies.studentHarm: A student might mistakenly learn that this benign tumour is specifically located directly adjacent to the outer surface of the uterus, which the lecturer did not state.

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The lecturer or transcriber used 'circumspect' instead of the standard histological term 'circumscribed'. Correcting this obvious speech or transcription error to 'circumscribed' aligns with the intended technical meaning and causes no student harm.
